row.title: Unlearn becomes an evidence encyclopedia of beliefs to unlearn
row.body: Rowan found the coaching-only Unlearn too unstructured. The tenant is now a clickable, encyclopedic site of popular beliefs the evidence contradicts, modelled on Practical Solutions, with each entry in a guided debunking order and an hourly evidence loop (Crossref DOIs, Europe PMC new reviews, freshness, review queue). The coaching tool stays at /coach.

title: Unlearn becomes an evidence encyclopedia of beliefs to unlearn
